test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 11 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are indicated by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the face showing '1'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f599a974f8f0190813ac75d95c2b26999f29e4d8556a8e93ae5230884258b1dd.png]
solution:
For this question, the relation is given below-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f599a974f8f0190813ac75d95c2b26999f29e4d8556a8e93ae5230884258b1dd.png] 

**Logic: If two dice have the same two face values in the given image then the third number is opposite to each other.**

In dice first and third.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7544d62bee1ed023c8ceb33e0feb6b84e20e0ebf031786c2e6e3be1c9be4464.png] 

Here, number **4 **is common.

Opposite pairs.

1 → 3

2 → 5

So, the opposite face of **1 **is **3**

Hence, the correct answer is **"3"**
